visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A macro close-up shot shows two hands pulling apart a dark, charcoal-colored loaf of bread, revealing a soft, fibrous grey interior with visible steam rising from the center. The background is a blurry, neutral indoor setting. (2) The scene shifts to a medium shot inside a bakery where a person in a navy blue shirt picks up a clear plastic bag containing a square loaf of bread from a wooden shelf. Other packaged breads are neatly arranged behind them under warm, bright lighting. (3) Returning to a close-up, the black bread is torn further to show a thick, dark sesame paste filling and white cubes of cream cheese embedded within the soft dough. The hands press into the spongy texture. (4) A new phase highlights a pink-colored square loaf being torn open to reveal a swirling, deep pink strawberry filling. The light highlights the moist and layered texture of the bread. (5) A series of small, round connected buns are pulled apart, showing a very stretchy and soft crumb with small dark spots of cranberry or chocolate. The setting remains focused on the hands and the bread. (6) A hand picks a small bag of bread from a wicker basket filled with many similar packages, showcasing the retail environment. (7) The video concludes with shots of various packaged products on a shelf and an exterior view of a bakery storefront with a green sign and a white awning.
